claims.note: Density bonus waivers and incentives; SB 330 vesting

construction_notes.text: Parcel match: the city page gives no APN and no site address is in county data. 359-08-031 is 2.92 acres, close to the stated 2.97, on the south frontage at the geocoded 20800 block. Matched by location and area.

State report 2024 lists APNs 359-08-025, 359-08-026 and 359-08-028; CEQA notice SCH 2025070351 lists APN 359-08-025. None of these is an active parcel in county data, where the site falls on 359-08-031.

Project description (2024-07-12): 59 three-story townhome-style condominiums in eight buildings at about 20 units per acre; Mission-style architecture; private decks or patios and a private roof deck per unit; small public plaza with seating and public art on Stevens Creek Blvd; all-electric; site zoned P(CG, Res) in the Heart of the City Specific Plan. Density bonus requests: waive the retail/commercial component, reduce setbacks, allow porches 9 ft into the front setback, raise lot coverage from 40% to 42.1%, and reduce parking under Gov. Code 65915(p).

CEQA notice (July 9, 2025): demolition of three commercial buildings; average 276 sq ft private open space per unit; 13,939 sq ft common usable open space; site in a Plan Bay Area Priority Development Area and Transit Priority Area.

SF YIMBY (June 10, 2025): units of 1,799 to 2,723 sq ft, three to four units per building; construction expected to take about two years in eight phases, one per building; contemporary Spanish style by SDG Architects.

San Jose Spotlight (July 28, 2025): construction expected to start the following year after the Staples lease expires in February; about $2.54 million in park in-lieu fees; the city had planned about 200 homes for the site and the developer used SB 330 to build 59; the city loses about 30,000 sq ft of commercial space.
